summary.oneLiner: The deck positions S&S Power Switchgear as "a 60-year-old Indian company with significant international operations and presence, delivering high-end T&D and Industrial Automation solutions" — an Indian MNC in Power and Automation that reinvented itself from Feb 2024 through corporate restructuring and a new management team and is "now on a high-growth path".

one-line thesis: S&S Power is transforming from a legacy switchgear manufacturer into a technology-led global player in high-voltage disconnectors and industrial automation, leveraging strategic capex, export growth, and proprietary systems like REDCon to capture high-margin niches in aluminum and energy sectors. With FY26 revenue up 43% and EBITDA margins expanding, it's on track to double revenue by FY28 while targeting 12-15% EBITDA and debt-free status.
guidance / outlook: Target doubling FY25 revenue by FY28; EBITDA margin of 12-15%; positive free cash flow; zero overdue payments; 1-2 tech acquisitions; 1.0-1.25% revenue invested in R&D; fair dividends; zero deviation in EHS/compliance.
order book & pipeline: All-time high backlog; international order from Egypt (Apr 2026); 765kV disconnector orders commercialized (Jan 2026)
segment / subsidiary detail: SSPSE: 36kV-765kV disconnectors, retrofits, spares; Acrastyle: protection & control panels for aluminum smelters; HART: customized hardware/software for aluminum plants, including POT controllers and FIRECon systems
growth verticals / optionality: Expansion into Vietnam, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Africa, Middle East; global exhibitions in Kenya, Rwanda, Ethiopia, Tanzania; potential tech acquisitions; digital twin and AI in design/engineering; UK market penetration
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin improved to 4.8% in FY26 (from 2.7% in FY25); cost optimization via lean manufacturing, streamlined PM/CM/SCM, and zero overdue payments driving margin expansion
capex / expansion: Comprehensive capex plan underway: 765kV commercialization, LVCC scale-up, WMS development, factory expansion, SAP implementation, solar panels, cybersecurity, and digital twin R&D
capital allocation: 1.0-1.25% of revenue to R&D; ESOPs for talent retention; proportional annual dividends; capex for capacity and tech; zero debt accumulation target by Mar 2028
risks & watch-items: Execution risk on capex and international expansion; currency/foreign regulatory exposure; supply chain delays; competition from global players; reliance on aluminum industry demand; technology adoption pace
non-obvious takeaways: HART’s REDCon system for aluminum smelters is a proprietary, high-margin niche with limited global competition; Acrastyle’s UK presence provides regulatory credibility and export gateway to EU/UK markets

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.

hero.oneLiner: The deck positions S&S Power Switchgear as "a 60-year-old Indian company with significant international operations and presence, delivering high-end T&D and Industrial Automation solutions" — an Indian MNC in Power and Automation that reinvented itself from Feb 2024 through corporate restructuring and a new management team and is "now on a high-growth path".

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- Group structure: S&S Power Switchgear Limited (BSE: 517273, NSE: S&SPOWER), headquartered in Chennai, with three fully owned subsidiaries — SSPSE (Chennai), Acrastyle (UK) and HART (Kolkata).
- SSPSE, established 1975, is described as "a pioneering High Voltage Disconnector manufacturer" with a five-decade legacy that has "deployed over 50,000 Disconnectors in 50 countries".
- Acrastyle Limited, established 1962 and based in Ulverston (UK), specialises in Protection and Control Panel solutions with "more than 25,000 units deployed globally"; acquired by S&S Power in 1995.
- HART (Hamilton Research & Technology Private Limited), established 1986 and acquired by S&S Power in 2024, delivers customised hardware and software solutions for aluminium plants worldwide (Pot Controllers, Heat Regulation Systems, Superheat Measurement Systems).
- Differentiation claimed on "superior customer service standards and in-depth engineering expertise", client-centricity and site-specific customisation, and built-to-suit retrofit solutions that "extend the lifespan of equipment" and lower customers' total cost of ownership.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- Strategic KPI to "Pay a fair dividend to shareholders", progressed by "Share our success with Shareholders through proportional annual Dividends".
- Targets to "Generate positive free cash flow" by FY 2028 and, per the summary slide, "becoming debt-free, by Mar 2028".
- Plans to "Invest 1.0 – 1.25% of revenue into R&D" and to "Create strong IPRs (1-2x per company / year)".
- Working-capital discipline: "Work with secured payment terms, towards zero overdue payments" and "Focusing on profitable orders, streamlining PM, CM, and SCM functions (Fin. rigour)".
- People/retention: "Become an employer of choice to attract & retain talent", "Create modern work environments and nurture positive work culture, offer ESOPs".

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Restructuring] "Starting Feb 2024, the company has reinvented itself, starting with corporate restructuring and inducting a new management team."
- [Acquisition] HART (Hamilton Research & Technology Private Limited) was acquired by S&S Power in 2024; Acrastyle was acquired in 1995.
- [Leadership] Krishnakumar Ramanathan is MD & Group CEO (30+ years, former CEO of Siemens Large Drives India); unit CEOs are N Balasubramanian (SSPSE), Nicholas Dunn (Acrastyle, eff. June'25) and Vikas Arora (HART); Ashish Jalan is Promoter & Chairman.
- [Framework] The "TOP+ framework": "Growth led by Technology, Powered by Ownership culture & supported by Processes, Plus a zero-deviation policy towards Quality, EHS, and Compliance."
- [Targets] FY 2026-2028 KPIs: "Doubling our organic revenues from FY 2025", "Improve EBIDA to 12 - 15%", and "Planning revenue growth at a CAGR of over 20% through Regular and Growth budgets".
